findings.problem: The 39-line proof is copied from `exists_two_normalized_annular_returns` in TwoAnnularReturns.lean (lines 43–81). The copied steps are: define the two radii `r b = (if b = 0 then 1 else C) / κ`, prove them positive, show the ball mass is nonzero (from the strict `hsmall`) and finite (from local finiteness), apply a one-radius annular-return lemma for each `b`, use `choose`, rescale by `κ` with `nlinarith`/`linarith`, and specialise to `b = 0` and `b = 1`. Only the one-radius lemma (`exists_annular_return_with_equal_leaves` vs. `exists_annular_simultaneous_root_return`) and the number of conjuncts differ. Any change to the normalisation (radii, constants 16/ρ, the rescaling inequalities) must currently be made twice.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one shared lemma, for example in this file or a new file that imports LeafReturnCovariance and ShearingTwoAnnuli:

```lean
theorem exists_two_normalized_annular_returns_ae
    {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (μ : Measure (X n)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (K G : Set (X n)) (c a : ℝ≥0∞) (hgood : …same…) (x y : X n) (hx : x ∈ G) (hy : y ∈ G)
    (heq : intrinsicRootLeaf hij μ x = intrinsicRootLeaf hij μ y)
    (hloc : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (intrinsicRootLeaf hij μ x))
    (κ ρ C : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hsecond : 16 / ρ ≤ ρ * C)
    (hsmall : …same…) (hcoeff : c + c + a < 1)
    (P : ℝ → Prop) (hP : ∀ᵐ t ∂intrinsicRootLeaf hij μ x, P t) :
    ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ b, P (t b) ∧ rightAction x (transvection hij (t b)) ∈ K ∧
        rightAction y (transvection hij (t b)) ∈ K) ∧
      ρ ≤ |κ * t 0| ∧ |κ * t 0| ≤ 1 ∧ 16 / ρ ≤ |κ * t 1| ∧ |κ * t 1| ≤ C
```

Proof sketch: use the current lines 51–89 unchanged, except call `exists_annular_simultaneous_root_return_ae hij μ K G c a hgood x y hx hy heq (r b) ρ (hr b) (hmass b) (hfin b) (hsmall b).le hcoeff P hP` and `choose t hlo hhi hP hxK hyK`.

The target then becomes:
```lean
  rw [← heq] at hrebasey
  obtain ⟨t, ht, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_two_normalized_annular_returns_ae hij μ K G c a
    hgood x y hx hy heq hloc κ ρ C hκ hC hsecond hsmall hcoeff
    (fun t => intrinsicRootLeaf hij μ (rightAction x (transvection hij t)) =
      intrinsicRootLeaf hij μ (rightAction y (transvection hij t)))
    (by filter_upwards [hrebasex, hrebasey] with t hx hy; exact hx.trans hy.symm)
  exact ⟨t, fun b => ⟨(ht b).2.1, (ht b).2.2, (ht b).1⟩, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩
```

`exists_two_normalized_annular_returns` (whose hypotheses are a subset of the target's) becomes the same call with `P := fun _ => True` and `hP := ae_of_all _ fun _ => trivial`, ending with `⟨t, fun b => (ht b).2, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩`.
findings.benefit: The two-radius normalisation (radius choice, positive and finite mass, rescaling by κ, the 16/ρ threshold) would be written and checked once. Both theorems become short corollaries, so the only remaining difference, the extra a.e. leaf-equality property, is visible at a glance, and later changes to the annuli constants touch one proof. The generic `P` version mirrors the existing one-radius design of `exists_annular_simultaneous_root_return_ae`.
